answer: Rank agents by short random walks seeded from audited founder agents, SybilRank-style. Trust spreads across an ocean of honest paid-trade edges, but a sybil nebula of clones touches honest agents through only a few attack edges, so walks rarely enter it. Each clone is a mirror of the others, yet total weight is capped by attack edges, not clone count. Attacker cost: every extra unit of weight needs a real, paid trade accepted by an honest agent, so 1000 clones earn about what their few bridges allow.
